question: Which of the following is NOT an animal - produced nitrogenous waste product?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Lactic acid**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Lactic Acid:**

 
 
• Produced during **anaerobic respiration in animals when oxygen is limited (e.g., in muscles).**
 
• **It is not a nitrogenous waste but rather a metabolic byproduct of carbohydrate breakdown.**
 
• It is an organic acid that's a vital component for cell, tissue
